 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al Nassr FC vs Al-Kholood match lineup for Saudi Pro League — Round 12 - First Leg, on Thursday 29-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al Nassr FC lines up in a 4-4-2 led by Ronaldo, while Al-Kholood sets up in a 4-3-3 led by Pinas. Al Nassr FC is led by head coach Ange Postecoglou, while Al-Kholood is managed by Des Buckingham. The match is played at Al-Awwal Park.
